name: Heart of the Astral Sea
introDiscord:
The Heart-Crossing Seal opens.

There is no dungeon behind it.

No corridor.

No palace.

No ruin.

You step onto a small island beneath an endless field of stars.

Around you float pieces of the entire journey.

Moonlit Reef coral glows beside Starfall crystal.

Whispering kelp winds around a Leviathan rib.

A lantern from the King's Festival hangs from one end.

Glimmer-sized lights drift between them.

And beyond everything—

there is open water.

No map.

No route marker.

No visible end.

heart-of-the-astral-sea-journey.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Heart of the Astral Sea.

left.message:
One Berry rests inside a familiar little shell cup.

Beside it is Shizuki's handwriting:

'Started with berries.

Ending with berry.

Narrative structure.'

right.message:
A small chest contains pieces from across the journey:

a silver shell from Moonlit Reef.

a warm starstone chip from Starfall Trench.

a silver leaf from Whispering Kelp Forest.

a tiny fossil fragment from Leviathan's Wake.

a paper festival crown from Sunken King's Throne.

and one shard of Nexus starlight.

Among them are Star Candies.

For once, nothing is trying to eat the treasure.

forward.message:
Starlight gathers into an Astral Heart Echo.

It resembles no single creature you've fought.

For a moment it becomes a Nibbler.

Then a forest creature.

Then a tiny Leviathan-shaped light.

Then a knight.

Then something made entirely of stars.

The journey itself seems to be testing you.

heart-of-the-astral-sea-footsteps.prompt: Deeper within Heart of the Astral Sea, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
Another Astral Heart Echo rises.

This one repeats movements from enemies across every region.

Not perfectly.

Like a memory trying its best.

right.message:
A small campsite waits beneath a floating fragment of Sunken King's
Festival Street.

Shizuki and Glimmer camped here before leaving the mapped sea.

Her final restorative bottle sits beside the journal.

The note reads:

'Rest.

Seriously.

We made it really far.

Even Glimmer stopped moving for five whole minutes.

Historic event.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the final restorative untouched.

The campsite is peaceful enough without it.

forward.message:
A chest opens beneath six tiny symbols:

a moon.

a falling star.

a silver leaf.

a Leviathan rib.

a crown.

a six-pointed Nexus star.

Inside:

Star Candies.

Obviously.

heart-of-the-astral-sea-horizon.prompt: Near The Open Horizon, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message:
A tiny travel box sits beneath Shizuki's handmade sign.

Inside are souvenirs from all six regions.

The sign says:

'EMERGENCY EXPLORER SUPPLIES.

Candy.

Map.

Second map for when first map becomes wrong.

Berry.

Optimism.'

right.message:
The last Astral Heart Echo forms at the edge of the known sea.

This one takes Shizuki's silhouette for half a second.

Then yours.

Then dissolves into a creature of starlight.

The Nexus remembers explorers too.

forward.message:
The final resting place is nothing more than a smooth stone overlooking
the unknown water.

Shizuki's last note before the horizon:

'I thought getting here would make everything make sense.

It did not.

Actually I have significantly MORE questions.

So...

success?~'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You sit for a moment anyway.

Some journeys deserve it.

boss-antechamber.name: The Open Horizon
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The stars begin moving.

Not falling.

Not rising.

Gathering.

Every region behind you lights in answer.

Moonlit Reef glows silver.

Starfall Trench burns blue-white.

Whispering Kelp Forest shines through its roots.

Leviathan's Wake hums with the old song.

The Sunken Kingdom's festival lanterns ignite.

The Astral Nexus opens every portal at once.

Something is waking at the center.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Open Horizon fills with starlight.

Scenes from the entire journey appear around you.

The first Moonlit Reef path.

The falling stars of Starfall Trench.

The whispering forest.

The ancient Leviathan graveyard.

The King's Festival.

The impossible halls of the Nexus.

They do not appear as separate places anymore.

They are one sea.

One journey.

At the center of it all, the currents gather around a vast luminous
shape.

Not a ruler.

Not an ancient organization.

Not the end of the Astral Sea.

Only the living memory of everything connected here.

The Heart of the Nexus turns toward you.

One final challenge before the map ends.

Use /yes to enter the Open Horizon or /no to stay with the memories a
little longer.

bossRetreatText:
You step back.

The Heart does not pursue.

The memories continue drifting around the island.

The horizon will still be there.

boss.revealText:
Every current in the Nexus surges toward the center.

Starlight forms fins, wings, roots, horns, coral, scales and shapes that
refuse to remain one thing for long.

For a moment, the creature resembles every region at once.

The Heart of the Nexus awakens!

completionText:
The Heart of the Nexus breaks apart.

Not violently.

It simply becomes light again.

Thousands of tiny stars scatter across the Open Horizon.

One enters Moonlit Reef.

One falls toward Starfall Trench.

Several disappear into Whispering Kelp Forest.

A long ribbon of light passes through Leviathan's Wake.

Festival lanterns flicker in Sunken King's Throne.

The rest drift outward through the Nexus.

Then everything becomes quiet.

A journal rests on the stone where the Heart disappeared.

Shizuki's handwriting fills the final pages.

'Okay.

I think this officially counts as a journey now.

Moonlit Reef:

Got lost immediately.
Found Glimmer.
Crab stole berries.

Excellent start.

Starfall Trench:

Gravity became optional.
Tasted comet.
Do not recommend.

Whispering Kelp Forest:

Vines learned crimes.
Forest became accomplice.
Glimmer encouraged both.

Leviathan's Wake:

GIANT BONES.

Still thinking about giant bones.

Sunken King's Throne:

BEST KINGDOM.

I was queen for approximately several afternoons.

Nobody recognized reign.

Political tragedy.

Astral Nexus:

...

I don't know how to summarize this place.

We walked through yesterday.

Argued with doors.

Met stars with legs.

Got attacked by geometry.

Found other versions of ourselves.

Lost gravity.

Found gravity.

Lost time.

Found time.

I think Glimmer may have committed several portal crimes.

But we made it.

All the way to the edge of the map.'

Below the writing is a doodle.

Shizuki.

Glimmer.

Six little symbols behind them.

And a huge blank space ahead.

Then one final entry:

'The map ends here.

The sea doesn't.

There's a current going farther out.

Nothing on the charts.

No region name.

No warning.

No idea where it goes.

...

Obviously we're following it.

Glimmer already left.

Again.

HEY—

WAIT FOR MEEEE—

I wasn't finished exploring anyway~'

The journal ends.

Ahead of you, beyond the mapped Astral Sea, one faint current appears.

It does not lead to another implemented region.

Not yet.

There is no seventh destination.

No new command.

No unlock.

Only the suggestion that somewhere beyond everything currently known...

the Astral Sea continues.

Behind you lies:

Moonlit Reef.

Starfall Trench.

Whispering Kelp Forest.

Leviathan's Wake.

Sunken King's Throne.

Astral Nexus.

Ahead:

the unknown.

For now, your journey through the Astral Sea is complete.
